newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady in slow market.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Friday amid low buying by spinners, brokers at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
There was not much business on Friday, the first official working day since the new government changed the weekend to Sunday from Friday, broker Nasim Usman said.
In the kerb market, NIAB-78 was quoted at 2,250/2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and MNH-93 at 2,525/2,575 rupees, he said, adding that rates were likely to open unchanged on Saturday.
